title: Centralisation risk with `liquidationResolver` as it can steal 100% of locked funds
summary: ## Proof of Concept  Currently the `liquidationResolver` has the power to steal 100% of locked funds in the following way:  1. Call `freezeFunds` for every user that has a locked balance 2. Wait some time until the liquidation delay has passed so the `require` statement in `liquidateFunds` succeeds 3. Call `liquidateFunds` and receive all of the users’ balances  This can happen if the `liquidationResolver` becomes malicious or is compromised.  ## Impact  Centralisation vulnerabilities usually require a malicious or a compromised account and are of Medium severity  ## Recommendation  Reconsider
